llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.structure
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.structure.boundaries
role Detect durable artifact, route, event, schema, migration, runtime, and command boundaries from generated local evidence.
owns boundary kinds, confidence assignment, boundary evidence
excludes framework execution, source annotations
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate

@llmnav.structure.modules
role Resolve repository-contained language modules without executing project toolchains or following metadata symlinks.
owns language module identity, Go module discovery, Go package import resolution
excludes dependency installation, external module lookup, semantic card generation
invariant Module resolution reads only regular repository-contained metadata files and never executes a language toolchain.
rel workflow>llmnav.project.scan, workflow>llmnav.graph.generate

@llmnav.structure.analyze
role Connect opt-in compiler or syntax declarations to semantic cards with explicit analysis precision.
owns compiler adapter orchestration, generated structural IDs, source freshness proofs, analysis publication
excludes dependency installation, project execution, runtime dispatch inference
invariant Analysis output is validated, precision is explicit and source changes invalidate it before publication or graph-input loading.
rel workflow>llmnav.graph.import, workflow>llmnav.search.discover

@llmnav.structure.compiler-process
role Bound opt-in compiler subprocesses and retain cancellation, failure, and exit ownership.
owns compiler process deadlines, bounded output, process cancellation, exit cleanup
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.go
role Prepare offline Go dependency exports and invoke the standard-library type analysis producer.
owns offline Go metadata, Go analyzer build, temporary executable lifetime
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.typescript
role Resolve an installed TypeScript Compiler API and run source analysis in an isolated process.
owns compiler resolution, TypeScript worker invocation
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.typescript-worker
role Resolve TypeScript declarations and symbol uses through the compiler type checker without emitting code.
owns compiler symbol identity, alias resolution, lexical owners, TypeScript diagnostics, selected source consumption hashes
excludes dependency installation, project execution
invariant Analysis executes only explicitly selected compiler tooling and never project application code.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.go-worker
role Resolve Go object identity and lexical references from standard-library type information.
owns Go declaration identity, cross-package reference resolution, receiver identity, physical source positions, Go UTF16 offsets
excludes project execution, module installation, runtime dispatch inference
invariant Compiler-selected production sources determine references and line directives never replace physical locations.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.metadata
role Validate generated compiler metadata independently of reviewed semantic cards.
owns common metadata contract, type origin validation, bounded member pages
excludes compiler execution, semantic inference, source mutation, semantic card validation
invariant Metadata preserves compiler origins and bounds detail output without modifying semantic cards or default navigation responses.
rel workflow>llmnav.graph.import

@llmnav.structure.typescript-metadata
role Project compiler types and callable signatures into generated declaration metadata.
owns TypeScript type origins, callable parameters, metadata categories
excludes compiler installation, source mutation, business meaning inference, semantic card validation
invariant Only compiler-resolved types and declarations supply metadata and type origins.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.typescript-worker

@llmnav.structure.python
role Extract Python declaration metadata with an isolated standard AST parser without importing application code.
owns Python syntax metadata, annotation origins, lexical ownership, syntax diagnostics, Python source coordinates
excludes type checking, import resolution, call inference, application execution
invariant Only explicit annotations provide types and parsing never imports target modules.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze

@llmnav.structure.rust
role Extract conservative Rust declaration syntax with explicit limits instead of claiming compiler type resolution.
owns Rust lexical metadata, declared parameter types, local impl ownership, syntax precision
excludes macro expansion, crate resolution, type checking, conditional compilation
invariant Comments, literals and macro token trees never create declarations and unresolved impl ownership remains unknown.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.rust-process

@llmnav.structure.rust-process
role Isolate Rust syntax analysis so deadlines, cancellation and heap failures cannot block the calling event loop.
owns Rust worker invocation, Rust analysis failure isolation
excludes type checking, macro expansion, application execution
invariant CPU-intensive Rust parsing runs only in a bounded child process and cancellation waits for its exit.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.analyze, workflow>llmnav.structure.compiler-process

@llmnav.structure.rust-worker
role Run conservative Rust syntax extraction inside the owned analysis subprocess.
owns Rust worker input decoding, analysis result transport, analysis error transport
excludes type checking, application execution, process lifecycle ownership
invariant The worker parses source as data and its parent owns deadlines, cancellation and process exit.
rel workflow>llmnav.structure.rust, workflow>llmnav.structure.rust-process
